steps.subject: sky
steps.action: paint the top sky with a wash
steps.load: small amount on the large brush
steps.new: blends into the wet base and gets lighter toward the horizon

steps.subject: water
steps.action: lay a small strip of water at the bottom
steps.load: blue with a little brown to dull it

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: dab cloud shapes with a pink tint
steps.load: white with the smallest amount of red
steps.motion: tiny circles, keep the brush moving
steps.rule: a little pink so the clouds do not look on fire

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: blend cloud bottoms and fluff the clouds

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: touch and pull distant tree shapes downward

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: highlight some distant trees with warm color
steps.rule: leaving some unhighlighted makes them look farther away

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: lift a faraway hill with yellow
steps.rule: the yellow mixes into the purple underneath

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: scrape out a basic barn shape
steps.rule: scraping removes loose thin paint so firm paint sticks

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: block in the barn with base brown
steps.motion: fill the shape with the knife

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: lay shingle marks along the roof edges
steps.motion: touch and follow the roof angles

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: highlight the roof edges

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: dark grey on an angled roof plane
steps.load: equal parts green and crimson plus white

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: highlight a spot where the sun hits
steps.rule: the sun would hit this spot

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: indicate boards and highlight a big door
steps.motion: touch the canvas to make boards

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: layer shingle rows up the roof
steps.motion: start at the bottom, one row at a time
steps.rule: this gives the roof a layered look

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: shingles on the lower roof

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: break paint into weathered boards down the wall
steps.motion: drag the knife down through the paint
steps.rule: broken paint gives the weathered look wanted

steps.subject: structure
steps.action: block in a big barn door and highlight it
steps.load: straight van dyke brown, then light color
steps.rule: the barn needs a door so the horse can get in

steps.subject: land
steps.action: fill the ground around the barn base
steps.load: straight brown with a little burnt umber

steps.subject: water
steps.action: pull a brown reflection for a small pond

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: tap grassy areas in layers, far to near
steps.where: land in front of the barn
steps.rule: layering far to near builds the land contour

steps.subject: path
steps.action: drop a road into the barn
steps.motion: drop in and let it fade

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: grass across the road

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: cut a water line and a couple of ripples

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: push a big tree out of the brush
steps.motion: push out of the brush and let it flow

steps.subject: other: wheel
steps.action: paint a hay wheel with spokes
steps.motion: go around in a circle, add spokes
steps.rule: the wheel pulls hay up into the barn

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: drop a couple of little trunks
steps.load: brown with a little white on one side

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: highlight bushes with yellow and green
steps.load: cad yellow with a little sap green

steps.subject: fence
steps.action: drop in a few fence posts

steps.subject: fence
steps.action: highlight posts and add three wire strands

steps.subject: path
steps.action: paint a small path with brown
steps.motion: let it mix with colors underneath
steps.where: a little path on the ground

steps.subject: path
steps.action: highlight the path with brown and white
